text:
Good day departures team,
Tranquil cycle behind us, one thing is left: crate labels

Please treat this as urgent follow-up from the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. The record set is nearly clear, but a few labels are still mismatched against the manifest notes, and that creates avoidable delay at handoff. I need each file checked against the crate tag, the booking note, and the acceptance form before the animal reaches the ramp. If you find a mismatch, flag it at once and do not rely on memory or a loose sticker. Supervisors have already reminded us that a calm passenger can still be carrying a serious concern, so the tone at desk level must stay steady while we correct the paperwork.

For the current cases, keep attention on the pet name, crate description, and any special handling remarks. <<FACT F078>> Do not add side notes to the inserted line, and do not paraphrase it in the log. If a traveler arrives worried, listen carefully, confirm the file, and send the matter back through the normal review path rather than guessing. One misplaced label can interrupt the chain from booking through pickup, and that affects every team in the handoff.

Also check the weight entry where rabbit travel is involved. <<FACT F064>> Make sure the crate label mirrors the approved record exactly, with no extra marks, smudges, or short forms that could confuse loading staff. If you see a handwritten correction, please copy it into the master record and let the senior coordinator know before the animal moves onward. We need clean files, clear labels, and fast notice on any exception so the evening shift does not inherit avoidable work.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
